targets.query:
weekMin = from(bucket: "${INFLUX_BUCKET}")
  |> range(start: -7d)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "env_monitoring" and r._field == "mq135_adc")
  |> group()
  |> min()
  |> findRecord(fn: (key) => true, idx: 0)

weekMax = from(bucket: "${INFLUX_BUCKET}")
  |> range(start: -7d)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "env_monitoring" and r._field == "mq135_adc")
  |> group()
  |> max()
  |> findRecord(fn: (key) => true, idx: 0)

rango = float(v: weekMax._value) - float(v: weekMin._value)

from(bucket: "${INFLUX_BUCKET}")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "env_monitoring" and r._field == "mq135_adc")
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({r with
      _value: if rango > 0.0
        then (float(v: r._value) - float(v: weekMin._value)) / rango * 100.0
        else 0.0,
      _field: "olor_pct"
    }))

panels.title: Rango ADC semanal por dispositivo (min, max, diferencia)

targets.query:
from(bucket: "${INFLUX_BUCKET}")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "adc_rango")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "adc_min" or r._field == "adc_max" or r._field == "adc_rango")
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: last, createEmpty: false)
